$comment: One LoRA adapter per VACA band role (see LLM_ORIENTATION.md). Each role trains
sequentially against the same base and is saved to its own adapter directory, then
registered with LLM Training Studio so it shows up in the model dropdown as
local/<output_name>. Trained with llm-training-app's own trainer:
python3 training/roles/train_roles.py --dry-run      # validate this file
python3 training/roles/train_roles.py                # train every role in order
python3 training/roles/train_roles.py --role guiBuild --role fastChat
'data' entries are repo-relative paths; each must exist, or the run refuses.
DATA SOURCE (changed): the previously-collected corpora were purged so that the
dataset describes only the current build. Every path below now points into
training/dataset/, which is generated from the live source by
training/vacalatest/build.py — see training/vacalatest/README.md.
FIT PER ROLE — read before training:
reasoning       good fit: how-vaca-works.jsonl IS this role's subject
codeGeneration  good fit: languages.jsonl is the per-language contract +
verified exemplars for the files this role writes
guiBuild        partial: the interface layer is TypeScript/HTML/CSS, which
languages.jsonl covers, but there is no dedicated GUI
blueprint corpus in the new dataset
fastChat        NO CORPUS YET: the new dataset contains no conversational
data. It is pointed at the system corpus purely so the config
validates. Do not train this role until a conversation corpus
exists — training it here would teach the wrong voice.

roles.why: Lead vocalist: knows VACA's blueprint, pipeline and triage, not general trivia.
Rhythm guitar: writes the file it is handed, to the scaffold contract.
Drummer: builds the interface layer the plan asks for.
Backing vocals: short, warm conversation so the lead stays free. NO CORPUS YET — see $comment.
